notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to cast the creature card.
description:
Cast a creature card from your hand by paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Intruder Alarm's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3.
